questions.q: Which flagship project leans hardest on AMM math and economic security?
options: The NFT marketplace
The DAO governance system
The DeFi protocol
None of them involve economic security
questions.explain: The DeFi protocol project centers on constant-product AMM math and liquidity-share accounting, which is why it's the project that leans hardest on economic security thinking.

questions.q: A student targeting a full-stack Web3 developer role is deciding which project to polish deepest. Per this lesson's framework, which should they pick?
options: The NFT marketplace, since it leans on escrow patterns, indexing, and marketplace UX
The DAO, since all roles need governance expertise
Whichever project is shortest to build
It doesn't matter which project a developer polishes
questions.explain: The lesson's framework matches project emphasis to target role, and the NFT marketplace's indexing and frontend/UX work most closely mirrors full-stack Web3 developer responsibilities.

questions.q: Which skill set does the DAO governance project lean on most, according to this lesson?
options: Governance design — voting weight, quorum, and treasury timelocks
Image compression for NFT metadata
Database normalization
CSS animation techniques
questions.explain: The DAO project's emphasis is governance design: how voting weight is determined, what quorum is required, and how a timelock protects the treasury.

questions.q: Does choosing a project emphasis mean skipping the other two flagship projects?
options: Yes, emphasis means only building one project total
No — this course still builds all three; emphasis just decides which one gets extra polish before showing it to an employer
Yes, but only for students targeting security roles
The lesson doesn't address this question
questions.explain: The lesson is explicit that Project 1 builds first regardless of emphasis because its patterns reuse into the other two, and 'emphasis' just means deciding which project gets a deeper polish pass, not which ones get skipped.

questions.q: What should a student do if they aren't yet sure which blockchain role they want to target?
options: Skip this capstone chapter entirely until they decide
Build all three projects to a working baseline, then push further on whichever felt most interesting
Refuse to build any project until a recruiter tells them which one to build
Build only Project 3 since it is listed last
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly tells undecided students it's fine to build all three to a working baseline first and then come back to deepen whichever project felt most engaging.
